intervals.quote: In this paper, we will present the overall design of the SBC experiment and provide an update on the ongoing construction at the Fermilab site.

intervals.label: commissioning at Fermilab, moved underground to the MINOS tunnel in May 2024
intervals.note: 'Is now being commissioned at Fermilab' (Snowmass white paper, July 2022). Talk of 17 March 2026: 'Moving to MINOS underground' 2024-05; first cryogenic operation 2024-09 (leak, cracked jar found); a year of repairs underground; first fill with LAr and LCF4 in 2025-09.
intervals.quote: The first physics-scale demonstrator of this technique, a 10-kg liquid argon bubble chamber dubbed SBC-LAr10, is now being commissioned at Fermilab.

intervals.note: 'First fill with LAr and LCF4' 2025-09, then 'continuous operation and data-taking for ~6 months' as of 17 March 2026. Calibration data; not a dark-matter search.
intervals.quote: 10kg calibration chamber currently operating in MINOS underground tunnel

placements.note: Built at Fermilab and moved to the MINOS underground tunnel in 2024-05 (same talk); Fermilab main-campus (surface) point used. Start is the earliest source describing construction at the Fermilab site.

target_mass.quote: The first physics-scale demonstrator of this technique, a 10-kg liquid argon bubble chamber dubbed SBC-LAr10, is now being commissioned at Fermilab.

target_medium.quote: liquid argon doped on the order of 100~ppm of Xe as the scintillator

threshold.note: A design target, not a measured threshold.
threshold.quote: This device will calibrate the background discrimination power and sensitivity of superheated argon to nuclear recoils at energies down to 100 eV.

summary.plain: A 10-kg test chamber of superheated liquid argon in the MINOS tunnel at Fermilab, used to measure how argon responds to very small recoils.
summary.technical: 10-kg liquid-argon bubble chamber (LAr doped with ~100 ppm Xe, 32 Hamamatsu VUV4 SiPMs, quartz jar, liquid CF4 hydraulic fluid, cameras, piezo sensors); calibration detector for the SBC programme, designed for thresholds down to 100 eV.

technology.quote: This prototype includes the scintillation system using liquid argon doped on the order of 100~ppm of Xe as the scintillator, and the light collection devices are 32 Hamamatsu VUV4 silicon photomultipliers (SiPMs).
technology.value: Scintillating liquid-argon bubble chamber (LAr doped with Xe) with SiPM light readout, cameras and piezoelectric sensors
